title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཙེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 186)
shelf_note: Derge woodblock folio of a pramāṇa commentary (perception of absence, memory, the bare spot of ground and the vase); belongs in the Tshad ma section of the Tengyur.

ocr_errors.image: དུས་གཞན་དུ་འབྱུང་བ་ཡིན་ནོ (as far as I can read the print)
ocr_errors.problem: verb misread; sense (memory arises at another time) roughly kept

tr_errors_A.problem: adds 'conclusion'; the text says it establishes non-confusion (unconfused cognition)

tr_errors_A.english: "this as well" refers to the specific location
one must also accept what awakens that memory
tr_errors_A.problem: the point is that the same experience must be accepted as also awakening the memory; rendering slightly loose (shared with B)

tr_errors_B.english: one must also accept what awakens that memory
positing a distinct real entity of non-existence is entirely without purpose
tr_errors_B.problem: interpretive expansion ('distinct real entity') put in the running text, though correct in sense
author attribution in keywords not stated on the page

pages.prefer_reason: Both are faithful with no serious errors; B is slightly more precise ('the spot of ground of that nature', 'non-confusion' rather than 'non-erroneous conclusion') and marks the objection/reply structure clearly.

book_verdict: A clean Derge pramāṇa folio with a good transcription (a few minor particle/verb slips) and two sound translations; nothing an expert would flag on sight.
